queries.query: Montpellier France official cadastral parcel map GIS API
queries.result: Found the official Montpellier Méditerranée Métropole open-data cadastre dataset and the official French DGFiP/INSPIRE cadastral WMS. The municipal dataset provides geographic cadastral data only; no literal/ownership data was used.

queries.query: Montpellier cadastre parcelles carte officielle API données ouvertes
queries.result: La recherche a confirmé le jeu de données cadastral officiel de Montpellier Méditerranée Métropole et le service WMS cadastral DGFiP/INSPIRE pour la commune INSEE 34172; les données géographiques sont diffusées sans données littérales.

registryEvidence: The municipal open-data catalog identifies Montpellier Méditerranée Métropole as producer/owner of the Montpellier cadastre compilation sourced from the DGFiP PCI vecteur plan. The official DGFiP/INSPIRE WMS exposes vector cadastral plan layers for commune code 34172. This is local/municipal and national cadastral-source evidence, not runtime adapter admission.

attemptedRoutes.route: Montpellier Méditerranée Métropole cadastre dataset page
attemptedRoutes.outcome: HTTP 200; dataset scope is Ville de Montpellier, annual frequency, Open Licence, RGF93 Lambert-93 metadata, and geographic cadastral data only.

HTTP 200; downloaded and inspected the ZIP. parcelle_Layer.shp contains 39,518 Polygon features, source CRS EPSG:2154, DBF update 2023-10-11, and native fields including Codeident, Ident, Sect_cad and Parcelle.
HTTP 200; capabilities identify Cadastre WMS - 34172 - MONTPELLIER, vector cadastral plan sheets, EPSG:2154 and EPSG:4326 support, and a geographic extent covering Montpellier.

attemptedRoutes.route: Bounded municipal parcel extraction near exact WUP point
attemptedRoutes.outcome: Local bounded spatial filter around [43.6153701485296, 3.86647003777739] returned three full parcel polygons; source identity was retained as Codeident values 340172   BV0156, 340172   BV0151 and 340172   BV0069.

requestsAndEndpointChecks.tls: Default certificate verification used; no TLS exception.
requestsAndEndpointChecks.authentication: No login, credentials, private token, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, or unsafe field request used.
requestsAndEndpointChecks.parcelResponse: Municipal ZIP shapefile parcel layer; bounded extraction converted to GeoJSON EPSG:4326.
requestsAndEndpointChecks.crs: Source EPSG:2154 (RGF93 / Lambert-93); retained sample GeoJSON is EPSG:4326 / CRS84 coordinates.

scopeLimits: Exact WUP point [43.6153701485296, 3.86647003777739] was preserved in latitude/longitude order; no coordinate shift or parcel-forcing was attempted.
The municipal dataset is a city-scoped compilation, but the retained bounded sample is not proof of complete current citywide coverage beyond the source metadata and feature count.
Codeident is a source composite identity containing commune code, section and parcel reference; it is recorded in metadata and normalized as the sole sample feature id.
The WMS is a display service and does not implement GetFeatureInfo according to its documentation; geometry was therefore retained from the municipal download, not fabricated from raster output.
No owner, address, contact, titleholder, tax/account, personal or other unsafe fields were requested or retained.
Packet completion records research and sample evidence only; serial reviewer qualification and runtime integration remain pending.

nativeFieldMapping.identityConstruction: Source-provided Codeident value, e.g. 340172   BV0156; no synthetic row number used.

compositeKeyProvenance: The source Codeident field is the native composite parcel reference observed in the shapefile schema; its values combine commune code 340172, section and parcel reference. The exact source values are retained only as the canonical id in sample features.

geometryDecision.exactWupPointTest: Bounded spatial filter around the exact point returned three polygons; this is local sample evidence, not a citywide completeness test.
